tools.name: assinafy_create_assignment
tools.description:
Request signatures on a document. Use `method: virtual` to sign without input fields, or `method: collect` to place input fields on specific pages. DigitalCertificate signers require `method: virtual`; other methods fail with code `digital_certificate_requires_virtual`.

tools.name: assinafy_create_document_from_template
tools.description: Generate a document from a saved template and invite one signer per role, by signer ID or full name and email. Find roles with assinafy_list_templates and validate editor_fields values with assinafy_validate_fields first. DigitalCertificate signers require a virtual template without placed fields. T

tools.name: assinafy_create_signer
tools.description: Create a signer in the workspace. Search with assinafy_list_signers first to avoid duplicates. Sends no invitation.

tools.name: assinafy_delete_document
tools.description: Delete a document only when the user's instruction explicitly authorizes deletion. Inspect its current state first; Assinafy enforces which documents may be deleted.

tools.name: assinafy_download_document
tools.description: Download a document artifact as base64: original (default), certificated, certificate-page, pades or bundle. Download the signed PDF only when the document is certificated and the artifact is listed.

tools.name: assinafy_download_document_page
tools.description: Download the rendered image of a specific document page. Use a page_id returned by assinafy_get_document. Returns base64.

tools.name: assinafy_get_document
tools.description: Inspect one known document: status, assignment, signers with their progress, pages and available artifacts. Read it before retrying a send or following up. 100% signed does not mean certification is finished; the signed PDF is ready at status certificated.

tools.name: assinafy_get_field
tools.description: Retrieve a single field definition.

tools.name: assinafy_get_signer
tools.description: Retrieve a signer's information.

tools.name: assinafy_get_template
tools.description: Get one saved template with its roles and field placements.

tools.name: assinafy_list_document_activities
tools.description: List the activities recorded for a document. Each entry carries an event-specific `payload` snapshot (keys vary per event) and the request `origin` (`ip`, `user-agent`). Use it to explain what happened to a document and when.

tools.name: assinafy_list_documents
tools.description: Search workspace documents by name or status, with pagination. Use it to find a document the user names before inspecting or following up on it.

tools.name: assinafy_list_fields
tools.description:
List the field definitions of a workspace.

When `include_standard` is enabled, records of type `signature`, `initial` and `signatureDate` are also returned. Match definitions to template placement field_id and ask about ambiguous names.

tools.name: assinafy_list_signers
tools.description: List the signers of a workspace. Use it to resolve a recipient to a signer ID; ask the user about ambiguous matches before sending.

tools.name: assinafy_list_templates
tools.description: List saved templates with their signer roles, pages and field placements (field_id). Template authoring is done in Assinafy.

tools.name: assinafy_list_whatsapp_notifications
tools.description: List all WhatsApp notification messages sent for an assignment. The response includes the rendered template text split into `header`, `body` and `buttons` — exactly what the signer would see. In sandbox/stage, WhatsApp messages are simulated (no real delivery) and button URLs include access/verifica

tools.name: assinafy_place_fields
tools.description: Open a visual editor to place signature, initials, date and input fields on a metadata_ready document, then send it with method collect. Takes the assinafy_create_assignment arguments except method and entries. Sends nothing by itself: in apps-capable hosts the user places fields and presses Send; o

tools.name: assinafy_rename_document
tools.description: Update a document's name. Only allowed before any assignment is created (i.e. while the document is in `uploaded` or `metadata_ready` status and has no signers yet); once the signature process has started or the document is certificated, the name is locked. The name is normalized: diacritics are rem

tools.name: assinafy_resend_notification
tools.description: Send one reminder to a pending signer in the assignment's active step, after confirming with assinafy_get_document that they have not signed. May consume notification credits; never repeat a reminder only because progress is unchanged.

tools.name: assinafy_review_signature_request
tools.description: Preview an assinafy_create_assignment call without sending anything: same arguments, checked against the document and signers. Use it when the user wants to review before sending. Apps-capable hosts render a card whose Send button performs the request; other clients get the summary as text, and the

tools.name: assinafy_send_pdf_for_signature
tools.description: Upload a new PDF, wait for processing and invite signers by full name and email, using Email verification and notification. This sends invitations and uses plan allowance: use only recipients the user authorized. After a partial failure, inspect the retained document ID and continue with assinafy_cr

tools.name: assinafy_set_assignment_expiration
tools.description: Change when an existing signature request expires, using an RFC 3339 timestamp. Assinafy may refuse for requests that already expired.

tools.name: assinafy_show_document
tools.description: Show a status card for one known document: its status, who has signed, who is still pending and when it expires. Apps-capable hosts render it with a reminder button; other clients get the same summary as text. Resolve the document with assinafy_list_documents first.

tools.name: assinafy_update_signer
tools.description:
Update a signer's information.

**Verification integrity:** `email` / `whatsapp_phone_number` cannot be changed while the signer has verified that channel on an in-flight (not yet certificated) document — the response is `400` naming the offending document(s). Already-certificated documents do not b

tools.name: assinafy_upload_document
tools.description: Upload a PDF without sending invitations and return its document ID. Use it when the user wants to prepare a document now and send it later with assinafy_create_assignment. Never upload again when a document ID is already known.

tools.name: assinafy_validate_fields
tools.description: Validate one or more input values against existing field definitions without creating a document or requesting signatures. Supply field/value pairs in values; the server sends the documented JSON array. Check each result's success before requesting signatures.

tools.name: assinafy_verify_document
tools.description: Verify a signed document using its actual Assinafy SHA-1 signature hash. Public lookup; requires no workspace connection and sends no credential upstream.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assinafy_list_whatsapp_notifications, assinafy_review_signature_request · Private data: assinafy_create_assignment, assinafy_create_document_from_template, assinafy_delete_document, assinafy_download_document, assinafy_download_document_page, assinafy_get_document, assinafy_list_document_activities, assinafy_list_documents, assinafy_list_fields, assinafy_place_fields, assinafy_rename_document, assinafy_review_signature_request, assinafy_send_pdf_for_signature, assinafy_show_document, assinafy_update_signer, assinafy_upload_document, assinafy_validate_fields, assinafy_verify_document · Public sink: assinafy_create_document_from_template, assinafy_get_document, assinafy_place_fields, assinafy_resend_notification, assinafy_review_signature_request, assinafy_send_pdf_for_signature, assinafy_update_signer, assinafy_upload_document · Destructive: assinafy_delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assinafy_list_whatsapp_notifications, assinafy_review_signature_request · Private data: assinafy_create_assignment, assinafy_create_document_from_template, assinafy_delete_document, assinafy_download_document, assinafy_download_document_page, assinafy_get_document, assinafy_list_document_activities, assinafy_list_documents, assinafy_list_fields, assinafy_place_fields, assinafy_rename_document, assinafy_review_signature_request, assinafy_send_pdf_for_signature, assinafy_show_document, assinafy_update_signer, assinafy_upload_document, assinafy_validate_fields, assinafy_verify_document · Public sink: assinafy_create_document_from_template, assinafy_get_document, assinafy_place_fields, assinafy_resend_notification, assinafy_review_signature_request, assinafy_send_pdf_for_signature, assinafy_update_signer, assinafy_upload_document · Destructive: assinafy_delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assinafy_check_fields" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assinafy_download_document" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Retrieve bytes only when needed. artifact downloads original (default), certificated, certificate-page, pades or bundle; wait for certificated status and artifact availability before downloading the signed PDF. page downloads a preview using a page_id returned by find_documents. Results contain base" → after: "Download a document artifact as base64: original (default), certificated, certificate-page, pades or bundle. Download the signed PDF only when the document is certificated and the artifact is listed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
